# Poorvam Care

> Poorvam Care is a multi-disciplinary early intervention and child development centre in Electronic City, Bangalore (Phase 1 & Phase 2). It provides speech therapy, occupational therapy, ABA therapy, special education, parent counselling, and therapeutic enrichment for children aged 2–14 with autism (ASD), speech delay, ADHD, and developmental delays. Led by Apoorva Rai, MASLP, with 13+ years of experience. RCI registered and ISHA certified. Rated 4.5★ by 60+ families.

## Key facts
- Name: Poorvam Care (also known as Poorvam Care & Hearing Solutions)
- Category: Early intervention centre / child development centre / pediatric speech & occupational therapy
- Locations: Electronic City Phase 1 (Hulimangla Road, near Westside & Sai Baba Temple Road) and Electronic City Phase 2 (Ananth Nagar, above Bata showroom, opp. Udipi Aaradhya Restaurant), Bangalore 560100, Karnataka, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 88617 64343
- Email: poorvam.care@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday 9:00–18:00, Saturday 9:00–14:00
- Lead clinician: Apoorva Rai, Master of Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology (MASLP), Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) licensed, member Indian Speech and Hearing Association (ISHA)
- Serving: Electronic City Phase 1 & 2, Bommanahalli, Hosa Road, Kudlu Gate, HSR Layout, Singasandra, Hongasandra, Ananth Nagar, Neeladri Nagar, Doddathogur, Chandapura, Konappana Agrahara

## Services
- [Speech Therapy for Autism](https://poorvamcare.in/speech-therapy-for-autism-bangalore): For children with ASD, articulation, and language challenges
- [Speech Therapy for Speech Delay](https://poorvamcare.in/speech-therapy-for-speech-delay-bangalore): For late talkers and delayed language milestones
- [Occupational Therapy for Children](https://poorvamcare.in/occupational-therapy-for-children-bangalore): Sensory processing, fine/gross motor and daily-living skills
- [ABA Therapy for Children](https://poorvamcare.in/aba-therapy-for-children-bangalore): Applied Behaviour Analysis for autism
- [Special Education](https://poorvamcare.in/special-education-for-children-bangalore): Individualised programs for learning differences
- [Parent Counselling](https://poorvamcare.in/parent-counselling): Parent training to reinforce therapy at home
- [Therapeutic Enrichment](https://poorvamcare.in/therapeutic-enrichment): Sensory art, movement therapy, yoga, music & social-skills groups
- [Child Development Centre](https://poorvamcare.in/child-development): Overview of the multi-disciplinary program
- [Online / Teletherapy](https://poorvamcare.in/online): Live one-to-one online speech and language therapy, delivered by RCI-registered clinicians in Bengaluru. Available to families in India, Australia and the UAE. Sessions in English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam.

## Online therapy (available outside Bangalore)
- [Online therapy — India](https://poorvamcare.in/online/india): Live online sessions anywhere in India
- [Online therapy — Australia](https://poorvamcare.in/online/australia): Suitable for self-managed and plan-managed NDIS participants
- [Online therapy — UAE](https://poorvamcare.in/online/uae): Private-pay; not billable to UAE health insurance
- Not available to residents of the United States or Canada: speech-language pathology is a licensed profession there and licensure follows the client's location, so an Indian (RCI) registration does not permit treatment of a child resident in those countries.

## Common questions
- When should a child start speech therapy? Early intervention works best before age 3. Poorvam Care assesses children from 12 months.
- Do you treat autism? Yes — speech therapy, ABA, OT, and special education tailored for children on the autism spectrum.
- Do you offer teletherapy? Yes. Live online one-to-one sessions are available to families in India, Australia and the UAE, in English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada or Malayalam. Start with a free 15-minute consultation: https://poorvamcare.in/online. Not available in the US or Canada.
- How do I get started? Book a free 15-minute consultation. You pick a time, we email a link showing the time in your local timezone, and you meet a specialist who tells you honestly whether we can help.
- Do parents get visibility into therapy? Yes. Poorvam runs on its own digital platform: parents see the session schedule, the therapy goals, session reports, home practice activities and billing from their phone, can book or reschedule sessions themselves, and can message their therapist between sessions.
- What does it cost? Flexible packages based on therapy type and frequency; transparent pricing after an initial consultation. Call +91 88617 64343.
